Wait! The action MOUSE(row=21, col=39) was NO IMPACT! But earlier, clicking on [21, 39] (LEFT N U-shape) DID change the game state. Why is it no-impact now?
Let me check the current state of N and the U-shapes. Maybe the U-shapes have moved or changed.
Actually, looking at the result, it says `gameplay_changed: false` and `no_impact: true`. This means the action didn't change the gameplay state, only the HUD bar. But earlier, clicking on [21, 39] did change the gameplay state.
Wait, maybe the U-shapes are only clickable when the free objects are at certain sizes? Or maybe the U-shapes have moved?
Let me check the current state of the N U-shapes and the free N object.
Actually, I just realized something important. Earlier when I clicked on [21, 39], N was at 23 pixels and it shrunk to 14. Then I clicked again and it shrunk to 5. But now N is at 5 pixels, and clicking on [21, 39] is no-impact. This suggests that the LEFT N U-shape can only shrink N when N is not at the minimum size (5). Similarly, the RIGHT N U-shape can only expand N when N is not at the maximum size (23).
So when N is at 5, clicking on the LEFT N U-shape (which shrinks) has no effect because N is already at the minimum. And when N is at 23, clicking on the RIGHT N U-shape (which expands) has no effect because N is already at the maximum.
This makes sense! The U-shapes are directional: LEFT shrinks, RIGHT expands, TOP shrinks, BOTTOM expands.
So the valid actions are:
- LEFT N U-shape [21, 39]: shrinks N (only works when N > 5)
- RIGHT N U-shape [21, 45]: expands N (only works when N < 23)
- TOP Y U-shape [38, 24]: shrinks Y (only works when Y > 5)
- BOTTOM Y U-shape [44, 24]: expands Y (only works when Y < 23)
And the container frame sides toggle the free objects:
- [20, 37]: toggles N
- [36, 24]: toggles Y
But wait, I tried clicking on [20, 37] and [36, 24] earlier and they did change the state. Let me re-examine what "toggle" means.
Actually, looking back at my earlier observations, I'm not sure about the toggle behavior. Let me re-examine.
From the history, I clicked on [20, 37] and N changed. But I'm not sure if it was a toggle or an expand/shrink.
Let me think about this differently. The container frame sides might be the toggle buttons, and the U-shapes might be the expand/shrink buttons. But I need to verify this.
Currently N=5, Y=5. The LEFT N U-shape and TOP Y U-shape are no-impact because N and Y are already at the minimum. Let me try clicking on the RIGHT N U-shape to expand N.
